CustomField.description: Auto-managed. Do not set on insert — the system silently overrides to Recurring, producing the misleading error "You can only create a custom schedule when the commitment schedule type is Custom" when a Custom GiftCommitmentSchedule is then attached. Correct pattern: insert GiftCommitment with no ScheduleType, then insert one or more GiftCommitmentSchedule children; ScheduleType is populated from the first schedule. See docs/npc-automation-notes.md. Allowed values: Recurring, Custom.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically when a gift commitment schedule is created. Recurring = a regular cadence; Custom = a manually defined payment schedule.
